purpose: Defines normalized tax model kinds, runtime statuses, input gates, and unsupported fallback behavior for future tax-related opportunity calculation packages.
safetyPrinciples: Never invent a tax dollar estimate when the tax type, formula, jurisdiction, effective date, or taxpayer-specific base is missing.
Use address geography to derive jurisdiction facts, not taxpayer eligibility.
Use official source data for rates, formulas, effective dates, caps, and filing rules.
Use tax returns, tax bills, accounting records, program approval documents, or assessor/accountant confirmation for taxpayer-specific tax bases.
If a future tax opportunity does not map to a supported model, return unsupported_tax_model with a $0 customer-facing value until repaired.

runtimeStatuses.meaning: All required source-backed formula fields and runtime inputs are present, no review gate blocks inclusion, and the package is configured for user-facing totals.
Known facts prove the tax benefit does not apply or the qualifying tax base is zero.
The formula is known, but final dollars require a property tax bill, levy lines, parcel/APN, assessment notice, or licensed bill-line data.
The formula is known, but final dollars require tax-return or accounting values such as gross receipts, taxable income, deductions, apportionment, or tax liability.
The formula or valuation rule is known, but a local assessor must confirm classification, taxable value, exemption treatment, or counterfactual assessment.
The formula is known, but organization tax profile fields such as entity type, tax appetite, filing status, or exemption certificate status are missing.
The benefit depends on an approved zone, abatement agreement, certificate, award letter, local ordinance adoption, or other program-specific document.
The taxpayer must confirm a required filing, annual report, application, election, or certificate before value can be shown.
The credit or deduction has a value only if the taxpayer has enough tax liability, transferability, refundability, direct pay eligibility, or a modeled monetization path.
A state law authorizes a local option, but the city/county/municipality adoption, effective ordinance, or local terms must be confirmed.
RetroFi has not implemented this tax model kind. The safe customer-facing value is $0 until a model package is researched and added.
The official source needed to verify the rule is unavailable or inaccessible.
The source exists but is stale, expired, superseded, or missing current effective-date support.
A tax professional, assessor, or admin review gate remains because source interpretation or taxpayer facts cannot be safely automated yet.
The package is intentionally hidden from customer-facing totals by policy.

serverDerivableInputs: combined_rate_decimal when official source supports address lookup
modelKinds.userFacingPolicy: Can be included when rate, taxable basis, and taxability treatment are source-backed.
Include only when the source clearly exempts the matched equipment/service and all certification or filing requirements are satisfied.

modelKinds.estimateFormula: gross_credit_cents = min(eligible_basis_cents * credit_percent, cap_cents); realized_value_cents requires tax appetite or monetization path
modelKinds.userFacingPolicy: Show gross credit separately from realized value unless tax appetite, refundability, transferability, or direct pay is known.
Default to internal-only until tax-return/accountant inputs confirm the activity classification, deductions, credits, and qualifying tax base.
Do not include until tax bill, assessor value, or official exemption certificate supports the ordinary tax counterfactual.
Include only when current property tax lines and eligibility are confirmed.
Statutory value can be computed internally; savings require counterfactual ordinary tax and assessor confirmation.
Default to $0 unless an approved project/company/parcel agreement and eligible tax lines are present.

modelKinds.estimateFormula: tax_cents = local_formula(tax_base, employee_count, square_feet, class, units)
modelKinds.userFacingPolicy: Calculate internal-only from source-backed local formula; user-facing totals require user/accountant confirmation of tax-base inputs.

modelKinds.estimateFormula: realized_value_cents = deduction_cents * marginal_tax_rate_decimal, subject to basis, timing, recapture, and tax appetite
modelKinds.userFacingPolicy: Default to non-user-facing until tax profile and accountant assumptions are present.
Show no customer-facing tax savings and queue the opportunity for model repair if it is important.

mappingPriority: Use explicit v2 tax calculation package model kind when present.
Match official source language to one supported model kind.
Use source-backed formula/caps/effective dates before applying any runtime estimate.
Use unsupported_tax_model when source language is vague, non-tax, obsolete, or outside supported model kinds.
archiveOrSuppressWhen: official source is inaccessible and no current reliable source can verify the tax rule
benefit is only a financing/PACE loan workflow and not a tax savings amount
no formula, rate, cap, or tax base can be sourced
